name: ModelVariant96_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant96_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (a flare glows on the attacking slot's joint, swings out dragging a six-image trail, a fan of triangles opens and closes and a burst sprite plays); for a non-negative request it selects the configuration indexed by the request and packs the textures, otherwise it runs one frame; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the French header-113/243 images build the same source unchanged, at the same addresses; only the resident call targets differ. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
